verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS testing and observability platform, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack only shows delegation through external assistants: Skills and MCP for Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot, plus a CLI and SDK. It also describes an automated pipeline that flags issues and suggests fixes, but nothing documents a built-in assistant users can hand tasks to inside the product.
